parameters.consumer: Selected FDAT source record7 grammar/SourceDescriptor qualifier before model projection; original VESTA never consumed the connection table here.
parameters.missingEvidenceResult: failed-before-apply/E_FDAT_SOURCE_LAYOUT_REQUIRED or E_FDAT_SOURCE_LAYOUT_UNQUALIFIED; preserve original full input, no false invalid-source or invented active graph.

framing: Logical records at most80ASCII bytes excluding separately preserved LF/CRLF.40I2 or26I3 plus2pad; all declared active numeric fields must exist and have safe bounded decimal spelling. Remaining line bytes must be padding; physical trailing padding may be absent only after every required value. Exact ceil(M/perRecord) rows, no next-entry consumption, cross-row numeric scan or inferred zero for a missing field.
topology: FirstN integers have implied FROM1..N;zero is a source dummy and may mean that atom connection was already represented elsewhere, not an atom0/no-bonds assertion. Remaining integer pairs must be complete and resolve to actual ordered record6 slots, including NSAT copies. Preserve raw token/order/dummies/repeated or reversed source relations independently of any normalized undirected graph; do not infer chemical bond order, unique site labels or an active SG periodic graph.
sourceIdentity: Capture actual primary resource SHA/span and source entry/ordered record6 slot identities. Record labels may repeat; use source slot identities and separately qualified Image/operator/shift mappings, not generated molecule IDs, inferred element-prefix identity or a naked new-lifecycle ordinal. Full SourceDTO7 typed metadata must encode actual current target IDs as EntityRef and raw source ordinals as I64; unresolved source record relationships stay explicit source facts.
currentAndOriginal: Source table observations and actual current model topology are separate. Locked legacy VESTA import may generate geometry-derived bonds but does not prove source record7 consumption. Full save captures current actual bond recipes/rules plus immutable complete source graph records/meaning/diagnostics; ordinary fresh reopen must restore each expected current object and source relation without rerunning the original table into a different edited model. Source-only archive or a matching rendered bond count is insufficient.
loss: Original topology/source records and edited current topology have distinct audited leaves/dependencies. Unknown periodic mapping or changed source atom/order dependencies block destructive native projection until qualified transform or explicit supported complete loss policy; no ad-hoc all-molecule lowering or synthesized connectivity. Missing original table is not loss of an observed empty graph.
immutableObservationSchema: fdat-connection-observation.schema.json FCON1, document-owned original source fact, not current graph; no SourceDTO7 root/product protocol change.
